name: Liam "MLink" Taylor
biography: Liam Taylor (MLink) is a speedrunner who loves to challenge themselves. Liam has performed several different types of Ocarina of Time speedruns. Aside from speedrunning video games, Liam has also begun learning to solder, always looking to broaden his horizons with different types of hobbies, usually ones that tend to be difficult. He aspires to one day be able to use his talents and skills for a future career in either hardware hacking or speedrunning. Social media: Website:
